comments.body: `getTemplateData()` was left mostly untouched, so if we decide/need to move codegen to the separate specs, we can do so with a one line change
the `getEvents()` functions were changed to return a set (well, a map) so that we could, in the new codegen logic, exclude GA events from the preview list
By adding a filter for `x-stripeEvent.kind == "thin"`, the same logic can be used to get thin/v2 events from the v2-only or the unified spec
Renamed from SpecVersion to ApiNamespace because we now only have one spec, but we still want to namespace our commands
Claude and I wrote this script to do a sanity check that there's a perfect 1:1 pairing of paths in the separate vs unified specs
